label: pre-specified later analysis (test numbers read after the v7 rule was registered)

arms.NB_F: no base features, fused (= A10 definition)
arms.B_NF: all 25 features, ranker score alone (no alpha log p fusion)
arms.NB_NF: no base features and no fusion (evidence + pattern features only, score alone) on the PT pool
arms.EV_NF_PT: evidence features 8-18 + is_extra flag only, no fusion, PT pool
arms.EV_NF_RB: same inputs on the RB pool
arms.G1: stored G1 (RecB top-150 pool, generator + evidence features)

definition.primary: FULL - NB_NF (base features + fusion on a common pool)
definition.decomposition: HRCOV_PAT - G1 = (FULL - EV_NF_PT) [base contribution, common pool] + (EV_NF_PT - EV_NF_RB) [candidate source, common inputs] + (EV_NF_RB - G1) [remaining: pool width, generator features, tail order]

evaluator: official py-tgb evaluator (hd_blend --no_controls over the promoted lists; TiRGN replay for polecat, stored float32 full rows for smallpedia); seed-mean per-query RR over seeds 0-2; H@k = mean over seeds

statistics.query_bootstrap: paired Poisson(1) bootstrap over test queries, B = 2000, seed 0 (hd_agg.boot)
statistics.timestamp_block_bootstrap: multinomial resampling of test timestamps (all queries of a timestamp, both directions), B = 2000, seed 0 (g7_cluster_bootstrap.boot_cluster); statistic = resampled sum of per-query deltas / resampled number of queries
statistics.intervals: two-sided 95% percentile CI from both bootstraps; one-sided 95% bounds L = 5th and U = 95th percentile
statistics.positive_claim: a difference is called present only if the one-sided lower bound L > 0 under BOTH bootstraps (Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05 within an item when an item has several primary comparisons)
statistics.null_claim: an effect is called EXCLUDED (smaller than the bar) only if the one-sided upper bound U of the relevant signed delta < bar under the timestamp-block bootstrap (the more conservative); otherwise 'not excluded'. bar = 0.005 MRR unless stated
statistics.MDE: reported only as sensitivity: MDE_80 = (z_0.95 + z_0.80) x SE_ts = 2.486 x SE of the timestamp-block bootstrap; never used to support a null
statistics.practical_margin: 0.005 MRR = the project's operational criterion (not a significance threshold)

interpretation: On the common PT pool, base features + alpha log p fusion add +0.00183 (polecat) / +0.00217 (smallpedia): present on both, gain >= 0.005 excluded on both. The HRCOV_PAT - G1 gap (+0.03408 / +0.00732, re-fit) decomposes into base-and-pattern contribution on a common pool +0.00863 / +0.00525, candidate source with common inputs +0.00438 / -0.00011, and the remainder (pool width 100 vs 150, generator features, tail order) +0.02108 / +0.00218.
notes: Fused arms: official = exact harness rank to <= 1e-7 MRR (hrank stored alongside rank).

Score-alone arms (B_NF, NB_NF, EV_NF_*): official scoring orders the promoted list by the ranker score and breaks exact ties by list position (base top-50 order, then the generator block); the preliminary exact ranks used strict-greater (optimistic) ties. Difference official vs preliminary: polecat EV_NF_PT -0.00012, NB_NF -0.00006; smallpedia EV_NF_PT -0.00183, EV_NF_RB -0.00192, NB_NF -0.00011 (all other arms 0). The registered numbers are the official ones.
Base replay: per-query base RR identical to the stored control/HRCOV_PAT files except near-tie blocks (polecat 0.011-0.012% of queries, mean |dRR| < 1e-8; smallpedia exactly identical).
FULL re-fit vs stored HRCOV_PAT: smallpedia identical (deterministic CPU fit); polecat -0.00005, ts CI [-0.00017, +0.00006] (GPU fit).

FULL - EV_NF_PT removes base features 0-7, pattern features 19-23 and the fusion at once (the rule's 'base contribution, common pool' term); FULL - NB_NF removes base features and fusion but keeps pattern features.
G1 = stored G1_K150 (RecB-trained top-150 pool, 19 features, official files from serverB). Decomposition terms are exact differences of seed-mean MRR and sum to FULL(re-fit) - G1.

expansion_check.rule: B/C items run on the two default bases only. A second base (polecat LogCL, smallpedia regcn_tgb) is added for an item only if its primary result is AMBIGUOUS: the timestamp-block 95% CI of the primary delta contains the bar (0.005) on either default base, or the two default bases give opposite signs with both 95% CIs excluding 0.
